title: PERSONA product pages, restyled onto organimo.com/seamoss
phase: Complete · every blind critic picked ours
lede: The bar is organimo.com/seamoss, captured on disk at 1440 and 390. Every piece below is built by one agent and judged by a separate agent with fresh context, which puts our render next to theirs blind, with the labels stripped, and says which one reads as the better-built commerce page. If ours does not win, the piece goes back to the builder. The loop ends when every critic picks ours.
foundation: 8 desktop slices at 1440x900, 8 more on a 450px half-offset, 17 with every accordion forced open, 9 mobile slices at 390x844 dsf2. The page runs a Lenis scroll container, so it only captures by driving main.scroll-container.scrollTop.

ref/organimo/spec.json and geometry.json hold the computed type ramp, colour census, radius census, hairline census, section padding and 32-column grid offsets read off the live DOM. Nothing in this refactor is calibrated against a memory of the page.
progress/PDP-BRIEF.md: what organimo does, measured; the devices to steal; where we deliberately diverge; the frozen content rules; file ownership per section; the class contract.
styles/pdp-core.css. 72.8 / 56 / 37.3 / 22.4px display ramp at -0.05em, 1px full-strength ink hairlines, 32-column full-bleed grid, 112px medallions, 999px pills, 62px sticky buy bar.

scripts/assemble_pdp.py builds the four product pages and one standalone preview harness per section from mockups/parts/*.html, so the layout can never drift between the four formulas and every piece can be judged on its own.
scripts/pdp_data.py. Prices, doses, absorption figures and the legal line are lifted verbatim and never bend to a layout.

rules: Never bend a documented price, dose or legal line to fit a layout. 249 zl open store, 179 zl/szt. in a personalized set. Doses exactly as documented; etykieta* where the document gives no milligrams.
Absorption is od 40x do 100x, w zaleznosci od skladnika, plus the four per-ingredient figures. Never 43x.

Organimo's hero carries a 4.8/5 star rating. We have no ratings, so that slot takes the documented specialist and shipping line instead. No invented rating, review, customer name, study or journal anywhere.
Expert voices only, attributed by role, behind a visible makieta chip. Stage I sells nothing and every cart says so.
Palette and typefaces stay ITP: navy, ivory, electric cyan, Inter, Space Mono. We take organimo's structure, rhythm, scale and devices, not its lavender.

log.what: Foundation closed. organimo.com/seamoss captured at both widths and measured off its live DOM. Eight builders dispatched in parallel, one per judgeable piece.

All eight pieces built. Frozen-fact guard clean on all five pages: both prices, every documented dose, the four absorption figures and the legal line survive the restyle, and 43x appears nowhere. No horizontal overflow at 390 on any surface. Blind A/B composites cut against the matching organimo region; eight critics dispatched.

Round 1 judged blind. Every critic picked organimo, so all eight pieces go back to their builders. Three defects in the judging rig fixed first: sections are now cropped from the real assembled page instead of a preview harness whose floating nav has nothing to float over, blind composites are cut into 1500px bands at native width after one critic judged a 390px page from a 200px thumbnail, and organimo's mobile accordions were recaptured open, because round 1 compared our open panel against their closed rows.

Gauntlet closed. Buy box, story, accordion, technology, social proof and store index passed in round 2; corrected chrome capture passed in round 4; the statement passed in round 7 after restoring the 37.28px five-line desktop declaration while preserving the mobile winner. Frozen-fact verification is clean on all five generated pages. Browser smoke at 390px confirmed correct titles, both prices, legal copy, buy boxes, and zero horizontal overflow; the mobile menu opens and updates aria-expanded.
